root.label: Meta invests in Scale AI and hires Alexandr Wang

events.label: Meta invests in Scale AI and hires Alexandr Wang

slots.name: investment amount
slots.sentence: Wang ended up joining Meta in an unusual deal in June 2025. The company invested $14 billion into Scale, took a 49% stake and hired the CEO to help overhaul Meta’s AI efforts after its latest model, Llama 4, didn’t meet expectations.
